title: Installing apps on the OS
summary: How apps reach the device: adding them to your account, tools for the agent, and access from the AMOLED.

blocks.text: In NomikOS apps don't install on the board: they're added to your ACCOUNT. The device is a touch display + microphone; intelligence and integrations live on the server. Switching devices doesn't lose your apps: pair another and they're still there.

items: Open Services and press Add to account on the app you want.
The api stores the link (service, x402 resource, network and payer at that moment).
The agent picks up its tools on the next turn, no restarts needed.
On the AMOLED, the app appears on the applications screen.
Tap Applications on the AMOLED dock and pick the app.
Long lists scroll with the wheel or by swiping.
Every real action pays its x402 toll with your dPaaS wallet (status shows in the dashboard).
By voice you can ask the agent to use the app for you.

blocks.text: Removing the link from Services revokes access instantly: its tools stop being offered to the agent and vanish from the device. The history of already-settled tolls stays in x402 analysis.
